newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-EVERTON INCREASE FOREST'S RELEGATION WORRIES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EVERTON INCREASE FOREST'S RELEGATION WORRIES.

text.p: Everton plunged Nottingham Forest deeper into relegation trouble when a Craig Short header was sufficient to earn a 1-0 victory for the visitors in their premier league match on Monday.
Forest's poor defence was exposed when Short headed Everton in front from Andy Hinchcliffe's fifth-minute corner and it was enough to give the visitors their third successive premier league win.

Andrei Kanchelskis wasted a late chance to rub salt into Forest's wounds with a glaring miss, but Everton were still able to savour a first away win of the season that lifted them seven places to eighth in the league.

Third-from-bottom Forest were desperate to claim their first home league win of the season at the sixth attempt but instead slumped to another demoralising defeat that leaves them without a win from their last 10 league matches, a dismal run stretching back to the opening day of the season when they were 3-0 winners at Coventry.
